Source: Baron's Otherworldly Citadel

Prerequisites: transformation class feature

Benefits: The powers of magical girls and henshin heroes are sometimes programmed poorly. Choose two of the following abilities. You gain the chosen abilities while transformed.

  • Delayed Defense: Whenever you stand up from being prone, you retain the AC and saving throw bonuses from being prone until the start of your next turn.
  • Disconnected Hitbox: Whenever a creature misses you with an attack, you gain a cumulative 5% miss chance until the start of your next turn, to a maximum of 50%. This miss chance is considered to be from concealment.
  • Fully Invincible Backdash: Whenever you use the withdraw action, you gain a +4 bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws until the start of your next turn.
  • Guard Cancel: Whenever an enemy misses you with an attack, you may spend 5 tension to take a move or standard action as an immediate action.
  • Miscalculated Frame Advantage: Whenever you attack a creature, if your attack would hit the creature’s touch AC, that creature takes a cumulative -1 penalty to initiative until the end of the encounter.
  • Missing Projectile Animation: Whenever you make a ranged attack, you may spend two points of tension to make that attack against the target’s flat-footed AC.
  • Missing Hurtbox: Whenever you make a melee attack, you may spend a point of tension to instead treat it as a ranged attack for the purpose of any of the target’s abilities
  • More Damage on Block: Whenever you succeed on a touch attack against a target, if the attack would not have hit the target’s normal AC, you may spend a point of tension to roll twice on all damage dice and take the better result.
  • Narrow Throw-Tech: When you begin or maintain a grapple on a target, you may spend a point of tension to increase the action required for the target to break free or become the controlling grappler to a full-round action until the start of your next turn.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time selecting two additional options

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
